description:
Why TrueML?
 
TrueML is a mission-driven financial software company that aims to create better customer experiences for distressed borrowers. Consumers today want personal, digital-first experiences that align with their lifestyles, especially when it comes to managing finances. TrueML’s approach uses machine learning to engage each customer digitally and adjust strategies in real time in response to their interactions.
 
The TrueML team includes inspired data scientists, financial services industry experts and customer experience fanatics building technology to serve people in a way that recognizes their unique needs and preferences as human beings and endeavoring toward ensuring nobody gets locked out of the financial system.

About the Role

The Identity team (IDNT) owns the systems that manage account state, client configuration, platform authentication, contact data, and credit bureau reporting at TrueML.

We support both of TrueML's legacy products: a digital-first third-party collections platform and a white-label, first-party SaaS product. We're also building their replacements on a new platform. Our new platform removes the duplicate functionality between the legacy two products, supports future offerings, and lets us retire legacy components.

What You'll Do:

  • Debt Management: account state, serviceability, and lifecycle events, in both the legacy systems and new platform

  • Entity management: a platform-level hierarchical configuration store. Attributes can be defined at any level of the entity hierarchy and overridden further down, so client behavior can be customized without code changes.

  • Authentication: machine-to-machine authentication using OAuth 2.0 client credentials, plus end-user login, token issuance, and authorization integrated with a third-party identity provider

  • Contact Verification: the people accountable for an account, their contact information and communication preferences, and verification of phone numbers, email addresses, and mailing addresses

  • Credit bureau reporting: a new capability being built in-house. It generates Metro 2 formatted files, manages reporting cycles, handles disputes and corrections, and tracks submissions to the three major credit bureaus.

  • Design and build reliable, scalable backend services and event processors for account state and lifecycle

  • Maintain and evolve legacy event-processing services and a legacy monolith while building their new platform replacements

  • Drive the technical roadmap for the Identity domain as the platform moves from legacy systems to the new platform

  • Own services end-to-end: design, implementation, deployment, and on-call support

  • Build platform-level services, like configuration and authentication, that other domain teams depend on

  • Work with other domain teams on cross-domain integration

  • Build and maintain internal tools for client configuration and testing

  • Mentor engineers and contribute to TrueML's engineering culture

    • Who You Are (Required):

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with 2+ years as a senior engineer or tech lead

  • Strong proficiency in Go

  • Experience with AWS, including Lambda and Cognito

  • Experience with event-driven systems, including processing event streams and building an account's current state from its event history

  • Solid understanding of authentication and authorization: OAuth 2.0 client credentials, token issuance and validation, and identity provider integration

  • Experience designing APIs that other teams consume

  • Experience operating production services, including logs, traces, performance monitoring, and incident response (we use Datadog and Observe)

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (we use Jenkins)

    • How You Could Stand Out:

  • Experience with hierarchical configuration systems or parameter stores (e.g., AWS SSM Parameter Store, Consul)

  • Experience with building phone and email features

  • Experience migrating functionality out of a legacy monolith onto a new platform (micro services)

  • Experience building internal tools with Retool or similar low-code platforms

  • Background in debt collection or financial services

    • Recruiting Fraud Notice: 

    We’re aware of fraudulent recruiters posing as TrueAccord or TrueML and contacting job seekers. To protect yourself, here’s how our real hiring process works:

    1. Official channels only. Our recruiters email only from @trueaccord.com [If you’ve received an InMail, you should verify the recruiter’s @trueaccord.com email] 
    2. No payments or financial info during hiring. We will never ask you to pay fees, buy equipment, or share banking information during the hiring process.
    3. No text or chat-app interviews. We do not conduct interviews by text message or messaging apps.
    4. No “portals” or access keys. We do not send PDF portals or access keys, or ask for passwords or login credentials.
    5. No resume services. We will never require an “ATS-friendly” resume rewrite or recommend paid resume services.

    If someone contacting you on our behalf does any of the above, it is fraud.

    Stay safe:

    • Don’t open attachments, click links, or share personal information.
    • Report the message as phishing to your email provider, and report fake profiles to LinkedIn.
    • Not sure? Verify by emailing recruiting@trueaccord.com before responding.

    If you’ve already shared information with suspected scammers: Contact your bank, visit identitytheft.gov, and report the fraud at reportfraud.ftc.gov or ic3.gov.

     
    We are a dynamic group of people who are subject matter experts with a passion for change. Our teams are crafting solutions to big problems every day. If you’re looking for an opportunity to do impactful work, join TrueML and make a difference.
     
    Our Dedication to Diversity & Inclusion
     
    TrueML is an equal-opportunity employer. We promote, value, and thrive with a diverse & inclusive team. Different perspectives contribute to better solutions, and this makes us stronger every day. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
